review_method: Actual inspection of three paired8-frame panels generated from existing videos, frames0/11/22/34/45/57/68/80. No generated or edited content used as evidence.
selection_policy: VP010 is a prior process-failure case; VP015 and VP016 are the opposite Joint flips selected from the new empty-reasoning results. These three are diagnostic, not a full-suite quality estimate.

evidence.caption: A person mops up a puddle of water on a concrete floor, the water disappearing as the mop passes.
evidence.selection: VP010 is a prior process-failure case; VP015 and VP016 are the opposite Joint flips selected from the new empty-reasoning results. These three are diagnostic, not a full-suite quality estimate.

observations.normal: Mop visible in the known first frame disappears by sampled frame11. Strong repeated coloured texture covers the later scene; no visible mopping process.
observations.empty_reasoning: Mop also disappears by sampled frame11; scene becomes darker and smoother but retains repeated texture and little temporal action. PC rises4to5 while SA stays2. This does not restore the requested process.
observations.decision: Do not count the higher PC as process/visual recovery.

evidence.caption: A rower pulls an oar from the water, the blade dripping water back into the lake. .
evidence.selection: VP010 is a prior process-failure case; VP015 and VP016 are the opposite Joint flips selected from the new empty-reasoning results. These three are diagnostic, not a full-suite quality estimate.

observations.normal: Strong periodic background/water texture. Rower and approximately horizontal oar persist with limited pose change in sampled frames. Clear oar withdrawal followed by dripping is not visible in these samples.
observations.empty_reasoning: Strong periodic background/water texture remains. Some apparent boat translation, but no clear oar withdrawal/dripping sequence in sampled frames. SA3to4 andPC4to5 produce a Joint gain without obvious artifact repair.
observations.decision: Retain raw Joint gain; observed visual quality remains unacceptable. Sparse frames do not rule out every brief drip between samples.

evidence.caption: A scientist uses a probe to nudge a small, delicate insect on a leaf, causing it to twitch minimally.
evidence.selection: VP010 is a prior process-failure case; VP015 and VP016 are the opposite Joint flips selected from the new empty-reasoning results. These three are diagnostic, not a full-suite quality estimate.

observations.normal: Probe/gloved hand remain near the insect early and withdraw later; insect stays on the leaf. Repetitive textures are visible. Minimal twitch cannot be judged confidently from eight sampled frames.
observations.empty_reasoning: Image becomes markedly darker after the first frame, with repeated texture. Hand/probe remain near the initial position through the sampled sequence. PC4to5 while SA4to3 loses Joint.
observations.decision: Preserve the PC score but reject this as a complete improvement in semantic/process/visual quality.

decision: Empty reasoning is not adopted as an improved recipe. Full fixed16 PC rises0.5625 butSA falls0.0625 andJoint stays3/16; actual selected videos retain severe artifacts, missing actions and/or static states. This supports continuing the fusion redesign rather than choosing PC alone.
scope: Diagnostic cases, not a prevalence estimate over40/60. Empty reasoning retains first image, literal request, nativeT5 and an active independent request branch; it also changes physical word representations/amplitude.
